title: A Native Footnote
caption: A single content argument creates a solo mark and its explanation. Native flow reserves the footer slot.

title: Choose An Inline Mark
caption: Decoration changes the passage without adding a note body. These anonymous marks have no number.

title: One Body, Several Passages
caption: Reuse keeps the original number and body; the next original advances the counter. The printer chooses the body position.

title: Declare The Body First
caption: Forward lookup resolves identity. An overlay margin follows the original even when its body was declared earlier.

title: Cycle Annotation Colors
caption: Each original takes one accent. Shared marks retain it and explicit component styles can override it.

title: A Callout With An Arrow
caption: The mark and body use one wrapper. Placement offsets belong to the body; the connector has its own route and head.

title: Highlight A Formula
caption: A region wrapper measures the actual content. Mark and body layers can be selected independently.

title: Attach Region Corners
caption: Pins can be attached around an existing object. Their padding is geometric: it adds no space to the object.

title: Restore Local Settings
caption: A Deixis block scopes its settings and numbering. After it ends, the outer defaults resume.

title: Keep Notes With A Table
caption: One block owns the whole figure and its caption. Its footnotes collect below the object with independent numbering.

title: Give A Body A Container
caption: Container options stay with the body. A stacked endnote group delegates to its single-note container.

title: Customize The Body Layout
caption: The marker helper supplies the destination; the content helper retains live spans. Use each once.

title: Build A Custom Note List
caption: Author data stays separate from identity and layout. Query records can supply custom catalogues without replaying body content.

title: Connect Ordinary Content
caption: Node IDs register bounds where objects are rendered. No detached list of object positions is needed.

title: Choose A Native Arrowhead
caption: Head size, fill, stroke and trimming are configurable. Numeric geometry and its painter work without note setup.

title: Cut A Curve Without Moving It
caption: Cuts hide intervals on the completed curve. Optional indicators are independent; the remaining pieces retain the original geometry.

title: Route Around An Obstacle
caption: The wrapper captures a policy for individually declared connections. Registered nodes stay fixed; the sharp orthogonal route avoids the middle rectangle.

title: Continue On Another Page
caption: A portal marks each accepted page boundary. The two fragments use each page’s geometry; no line is drawn across the intervening document.

title: Follow Endnotes In The Header
caption: The header reads complete body spans on its physical page, then gathers all original and reused mark pages. Querying never renders an explanation again. These source page numbers are physical; native page-label formatting is a separate step.

title: Reveal An Annotation With Its Passage
caption: Touying renders two subslides. The second reveals the region, connector and callout together; hidden declarations retain their semantic ownership.

title: Separate Readings From Commentary
caption: Independent series give source readings and editorial comments their own numbering. A custom renderer adds a lemma; reused passages share one reading.

title: Find Open Review Comments
caption: Author and status are ordinary annotation data. A filtered linked view selects open comments without removing resolved notes from the draft.

title: Link Terms To Their First Use
caption: Explicit originals choose the first use. A sorted catalogue displays safe definition summaries without printing or executing their endnote bodies.
